description: This file defines a report generation module for a Scrum sprint burndown chart in an OpenERP/Odoo environment. It includes classes for rendering PDF reports and creating burndown charts based on sprint data.

classes.name: external_pdf
classes.description: A class for rendering PDF content from a byte stream.

classes.name: report_tasks
classes.description: A class responsible for generating a burndown chart report for a Scrum sprint.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for external_pdf, initializes with a PDF byte stream.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Generates the burndown chart PDF for a given sprint, executes SQL queries to fetch sprint and task data, computes burndown data, and draws the chart.
